newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel cargo supply tight, barges easier.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel cargo supply tight, barges easier.

text.p: NWE jet fuel cargo premiums were steady to firmer on Thursday with good demand hunting scarce larger parcels, but barges weakened on selling pressure, traders said.

Benchmark Dec IPE futures firmed $1.50 to $217.75 a tonne, boosted by gains in NYMEX heating oil. NWE premiums were around Dec IPE +$33/34, anout $1 firmer. In the Med, values were around fob Med high +$5 with traders examining a potential arb to the east.

A barge was done at Jan IPE +$28 for December 10-20 fob Rotterdam. Another traded at Dec IPE +$29.25 fob ARA. Some traders later said the barge market was weaker, assessing the market at Dec IPE +25/26.
